scope: Current annual salary entitlements independently checked as of October 11, 2026. Each fact records the year, effective term, official base and applicable statutory adjustment in its locator; published current compensation schedules take precedence over superseded statutory bases. Future rates, expenses and leadership supplements are excluded. Missing comparable annual figures remain explicitly labeled estimates. Only factual amounts and independently written locators are recorded; publisher tables and identity records are not reproduced.
rounding: Round annual dollar amounts to the nearest whole dollar.
